text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's Halloween, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All the pranks... no, all the tricks I want!
Nishishi, I'm gonna play tons of tricks on everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
City!!
Trick or trick, nanoda!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Surrender! Prepare to be chomped~~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just like Hishi Ama-senpai said, huh.
In that case――

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If you're going to bite, please bite over here instead.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Taiyaki!
It's got just the right amount of sweetness, so delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you give them candy, you won't get prankedâ
that's the Halloween rule, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Guh!?
Halloween's only weakness, 'Treat'!
How did you know about that!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Everyone knows. For now, well... Happy Halloween, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I messed up, noda.
To think they'd treat me instead..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: “Still, Windy-chan is a genius! Next time, before you can treat me, I'll chomp—”

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Windy-san spotted, desu!
Treats, start♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Plop!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? Munch... munch?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This heft... Is it a taiyaki?
Wait, shoving it into someone's mouth is dangerous, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"It is all right! I definitely gave it to you!
Happy Halloween~♪"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...This is strange!
I already ate two whole taiyaki!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guuuuuughhh...!! I won't mess up this time! Just on reflex—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hm? Could that be――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *Chomp!!!!*

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Is that taiyaki?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-You scared the life out of me~~...!
I thought you were going to bite my ear right off?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, why is everyone
handing me taiyaki?!
I'll never get to do any tricks at this rate!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! That means Hishi Ama-san's fortune-telling
was spot on, then!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I figured Windy-san would be rearing to go, so before she could trick us, I decided to treat everyone... and handed out taiyaki to all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I was skeptical at first, but...
the taiyaki really protected me!
All praise to the Great Goddess Hishiama~.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Which means Hishiama got in my way!
It's ALWAYS like this!! Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Still, they paid a lot of attention to me.
And the taiyaki was delicious, too...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Nishishi, operation continues!
Trick or taiyaki, baby!♪
